title: Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2610.14389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score

translated_title: 跨基准测试、推理模式与硬件平台测量开放权重LLM的推理能效
translated_abstract: 基准测试分数能告诉我们一个LLM能做什么，却无法告诉我们实现这种能力需要消耗多少能量。我们对86个开放权重模型检查点直接测量了这一权衡关系，评估涵盖七个基准测试和六个硬件平台（从消费级GPU到八GPU服务器不等）。我们发现，即使在能力相近的模型之间，能效也存在巨大差异。大多数配置远离分数-能量帕累托前沿：与另一个得分至少相当的其他配置相比，它们的中位数能耗高出2.6至4.8倍，最大差异可达27倍。推理可以提升能力，但启用思考模式平均会使能耗增加约3.7倍，且其收益高度依赖于模型家族和输出预算。生成token数量也不是能耗的可靠替代指标，会导致18%至24%的模型对出现排序错误。相比之下，FP8量化可将能耗降低约四分之一，而分数几乎没有变化。
tldr: 该研究对86个开放权重LLM在7个基准测试和6种硬件平台上的推理能耗进行了直接测量，发现能力相近的模型间能耗差异最高可达27倍、开启思考模式平均使能耗增加约3.7倍，而FP8量化能以几乎不损失性能的代价将能耗降低约四分之一。
en_tdlr: This paper directly measures inference energy efficiency across 86 open-weight LLM checkpoints on 7 benchmarks and 6 hardware platforms, finding that similarly capable models can differ in energy use by up to 27×, enabling thinking increases energy by ~3.7× on average, and FP8 cuts energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score.
